newsitem.title: USA: N.C. Rep. Charles Taylor has medical tests.
newsitem.headline: N.C. Rep. Charles Taylor has medical tests.

text.p: North Carolina Representative Charles Taylor was admitted to a hospital to have tests for an unspecified illness, Taylor's press secretary, Roger France, said Thursday.
France said Taylor, a Republican, was admitted Tuesday to Memorial Mission Hospital in Asheville.
"He is in serious but stable condition," France said.
France did not say why the congressman was in the hospital. He planned to meet Taylor later Thursday and would have more details then.
Taylor, 56, is a member of the House Appropriations Committee and is in his fourth term as a U.S. lawmaker.
